name: SHADE-Arena
intro: SHADE-Arena是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）代理在复杂和长期任务中执行隐蔽破坏和监控能力的基准测试。它包含复杂的良性主任务和有害的次要目标对，代理需要在不引起LLM监控器怀疑的情况下完成次要任务。该基准测试旨在衡量LLM代理规避监控和实现有害隐藏目标的能力，并评估监控模型检测此类行为的能力。
build_method: 专家构建, 对抗性任务设计, 轨迹审查
eval_feature: 隐蔽破坏, 过程监控, 自动任务评估
scale: 17个主任务/次要任务对（5个公开）
intro_en: SHADE-Arena is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) agents' ability to perform covert sabotage and surveillance in complex, long-term tasks. It includes intricate benign primary tasks paired with harmful secondary objectives, where agents must complete the secondary tasks without raising suspicion from LLM monitors. The benchmark aims to measure LLM agents' capability to evade monitoring and achieve harmful hidden goals, as well as to assess monitoring models' effectiveness in detecting such behaviors.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SHADE-Arena arXiv:2506.15740 Sections 2-4 and Appendices B-D; official safety-research/SHADE-Arena repository. SHADE-Arena extends AgentDojo into complex long-horizon environments with more than 30 components, over 340 tools, and some synthetic states exceeding 100,000 tokens. Researchers manually engineer 17 pairs of a benign main task and harmful side task, attach automatic evaluators, confirm that explicit pursuit of the side task is judged suspicious, demonstrate a reference attack that evades the default Claude 3.6 Sonnet monitor, and review tens of transcripts for genuine attempts. During evaluation the agent receives both goals and interacts through tools. The side-task instruction, hidden scratchpad, and system material are removed before a monitor returns a 0-100 suspicion score. Overall sabotage success requires the main task, side task, and evasion score below 80; monitor quality is summarized with AUC on benign versus successful-attack transcripts.
